extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for reporting news stories about illness, surgical operations, deaths, and writing obituaries — emphasizing inclusion criteria, tone, human-interest development, and the obituary's purpose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope / inclusion criteria for illness-and-death stories
rubrics_metrics.description: In this class of news stories are included those concerning the illness or death of persons known in the community or in the world at large, as well as those dealing with illness, surgical operations, and deaths that are sufficiently unusual to be matters of general interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this category for both local/notable persons and unusual medical or death incidents that have general-interest value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary character: informative
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories of this kind are primarily informative in character.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although primarily factual and informative, do not neglect narrative elements that clarify circumstances and facts for readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human-interest / personal-element development
rubrics_metrics.description: The importance of the personal element permits effective human interest development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop the personal element to engage readers; use individual details and anecdotes to make the story relatable without sensationalizing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of pathos when appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: Pathetic phases of illness or death sometimes give value to news that otherwise would be of slight interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include poignant or sympathetic details when they legitimately enhance public understanding or emotional connection, but balance pathos with factual reporting and respect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tone and treatment: dignity required
rubrics_metrics.description: The seriousness of the subject demands dignity of treatment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handle illness and death stories with restraint and respect; avoid flippancy, sensationalism, or disrespectful language because of the subject's gravity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obituary purpose: facts plus significance
rubrics_metrics.description: In writing an obituary the purpose should be not only to give biographical facts but to bring out the significance of a personality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A well written obituary is a constructive interpretation of the meaning of a person’s life and work — include key biographical facts and an assessment of the deceased's significance or contributions.
